verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents an official MCP server (agent-toolkit) that lets AI tools like Claude/Cursor/Windsurf query Mastercard services including Open Finance use cases (e.g., verifying account ownership, checking balances), confirmed by a dedicated docs page and probe. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server working specifically with Open Finance endpoints, and more detail on setup/auth flow for the MCP server itself.
